source.title: From Global Ambition into National Action: Take Aways from 35 EW4All Roadmaps

interpretation_boundary: These are WMO-published aggregates for 35 government-validated national roadmaps, not an independently collected NOEMA dataset.
The 960 million figure describes population represented by the roadmaps; it is not a count of people who actually received or acted on warnings.
The USD 1.38 billion total covers only the 20 roadmaps with clear budget allocations; the derived USD 69 million mean is not a universal country cost or a Georgia budget estimate.
The underlying 35 roadmap documents and country-level extraction table were not independently re-analysed in this snapshot.
